data.narrative:
Zeromark is a seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Joel Anderson that has raised $10M+. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—spanning seed and Series A stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $10M total raised as a proxy base and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical for seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $25M. Peer-median analysis examines four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Stark Defence ($4.0B, Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A). The median of these four peers is $700M, with a range of $125M to $4.0B.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $21M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $362M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty in peer selection and stage comparability within the Defense & Security sector, where valuations vary substantially by technology maturity and customer traction. The stage-progression method anchors conservatively to deployed capital, while the peer-median approach is sensitive to the inclusion of UFORCE at $1.0B valuation. Resolution of valuation range will depend on clarity regarding Zeromark's technical differentiation and early customer validation relative to named comparables.
